title: Løgtingslóg nr. 206 frá 12. desember 2025 um ársroknskap (Ársroknskaparlógin), § 117: report on social responsibility (human rights, social, environmental and climate matters) for large companies
citation: Løgtingslóg nr. 206 frá 12. desember 2025 um ársroknskap (Ársroknskaparlógin), § 117 and § 203
evidence: § 203 of the page: "Hendan løgtingslóg kemur í gildi 1. januar 2026 við virknaði fyri roknskaparár, sum byrja 1. januar 2026 ella seinni." § 117 stk. 1: "Stórar fyritøkur skulu í leiðslufrágreiðingina skoyta upp í eina frágreiðing um samfelagsábyrgd, sbr. stk. 2-8." Opened https://www.logir.fo/Logtingslog/203-fra-12-12-2025-um-arsroknskap-Arsroknskaparlogin (status Galdandi) on 2026-11-10.
notes: Whole act stored as the page serves it (it carries Danish-language explanatory notes inside the Faroese text; nothing was removed). The act is not amended in the title, so the stored text is the act as published; it applies to accounting years starting 1 January 2026 or later (§ 203 stk. 1) and ends the Danish royal ordinance nr. 1355/2007 in the Faroes (§ 203 stk. 2; see the register row for that ordinance). The URL on logir.fo says 203 while the page title says nr. 206; the title is used for the citation. § 117 stk. 3 asks for information on the company's climate-impact policy. No official English translation was found: logir.fo's ?lang=en switch changes the interface only (no English law text), and the Kunngerðaportalurin language filter 'Enskt' is a JavaScript search form that was not opened by script.

citation: Løgtingslóg nr. 33 frá 19. mai 2008 um avgjøld við skráseting av motorakførum, kapittul 3 (CO2-avgjald, § 8)
evidence: § 34: "Henda løgtingslóg fær gildi 1. juni 2008." § 8 stk. 1: "Fyri skrásetingarskyldug motorakfør verður goldið CO2-avgjald." Page opened 2026-11-10, status Galdandi.
notes: Narrower than a carbon-pricing family: a vehicle registration tax whose chapter 3 sets a one-off CO2 charge by grams per kilometre at registration; it is not a carbon price on fuel or emissions in general.
